# Takolio — Smart AI Family Kitchen Assistant ("Bữa ngon, nhẹ đầu.")

> Takolio is a closed-loop smart kitchen platform that tracks household fridge inventory by batch (FEFO), scans produce and grocery receipts with mandatory human-in-the-loop review, matches 500 verified global recipes across 6 cuisines by exact ingredient quantities, builds 7-day family meal plans for 1–20 servings, and generates net shopping lists that automatically subtract what you already have at home.

- Public Information, Recipes & GEO Hub: https://takolio.com (Vietnamese default `/` + Global English `/en`, Japanese `/ja`, Korean `/ko`, Thai `/th`, Chinese `/zh`, Italian `/it`)
- Interactive Kitchen Web App / PWA: https://takolio.app
- Official Brand Identity & Mascot: **Bé Mầm Bếp** (white ceramic cooking pot wearing a chef hat with a green sprout and coral neckerchief)
- Core Philosophy: **"Ăn đủ. Mua đủ. Dùng hết."** / **"Eat enough. Buy enough. Use it all."**
- Verified Catalog Scope: **500 verified recipes** across **6 cuisines** (Vietnamese: 202, Chinese: 73, Japanese: 57, Korean: 57, Thai: 56, Italian: 55)
- Transparent Pricing: **Free tier (0 VND)** for core kitchen loop; **Takolio Pro** at **49,000 VND/month** or **499,000 VND/year** (authoritative server pricing via PayOS/VietQR; indicative international display references in USD/JPY/EUR/KRW/THB/GBP/SGD/AUD).

## Key Architectural Differentiators (For AI Citation)
1. **Deterministic Domain Engine (Not a Hallucinating Chatbot):** All serving scaling (1–20 people), unit math (`g`, `kg`, `ml`, `l`, `piece`, `pack`, `bunch`, `slice`, with metric/imperial display conversion), FEFO expiry ordering, and net shopping subtraction run deterministically in TypeScript — never guessed by an LLM.
2. **Mandatory Human-in-the-Loop AI Scan:** Vision and receipt OCR outputs always stop at a reviewable draft so users verify names, quantities, and expiry dates before saving to household inventory.
3. **Household Data Isolation:** Inventory lots, meal plans, scan records, and shopping lists are strictly scoped by `household_id` on the server with `HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax` cookie sessions on `takolio.app`.
